2115919935813931228.en_summary: $AMZN CEO on AWS growth: “At this scale, to be projecting growing over 40% year over year in each of 2027 and 2028 is pretty significant. And the fact that we believe that this can be a trillion-dollar revenue business in 5 to 10 years, it's an extraordinarily unusual opportunity that we're very excited to be pursuing.” Quoted CFO: AWS revenue was $46B, grew 39.3% YoY, added $3.8B in QoQ revenue, annualized run rate of $184B.
